feat(transport): answer list_sessions off the turn lock

Thread the session store through createMessageHandler and answer a
list_sessions frame on the path a turn's lock does not hold, so a
history request does not queue behind a streaming answer. The list is
always the connection's own: the id comes from the upgrade, any
frame-supplied one having been dropped by the validator. A store
without listFor answers an empty session_list; a throwing one logs on
the ws category and answers SERVER_ERROR. Answers are chained per
socket, so a frame that must await its store cannot let the frame
behind it overtake its answer.

The ws suites' duplicated scaffolding moves into wsTestSupport, a
boolean literal argument in validation.test.ts becomes a comprehension
and the specs' test anchors follow the shifted lines.

References #144

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
